description: Studio pipeline job type (Story 34.8, user flow F9): run one game project's epic as a playable vertical slice. The engine runs the story as run-epic does (tk-studio-launch distills the epic SPEC, bootstraps the first story's task manifest at the planner tier, starts bmad-loop detached with a pre-minted run id); the supervisor's host leg then runs, in order, the project's host command, the asset ladder's check, greybox and match (never generate, never --mirror), the engine gate and the playable-verify leg (with a contact sheet of its frames), and the close-out commits the placed art and the proof media (report, frames, contact sheet) under .tk-studio/proof/<run_id>/ before the PR. Approval mints run-epic-N instances of this type for an engagement whose record carries game: true.
